_comment: Hand-curated overlay for item effects that meraki only has as text.
Numbers transcribed from the ddragon/meraki text in the current
data/items snapshot — re-check whenever a new patch lands. Fields:
apMult           AP multiplier (Rabadon 0.30 -> x1.30; multiplicative between items)
apFromBonusHpPct AP equal to this % of bonus (item) health
apFromBonusManaPct  AP equal to this % of bonus (item) mana (Seraph's Awe)
adFromMaxManaPct    bonus AD equal to this % of maximum mana (Muramana Awe)
critChanceStackedPct permanent on-attack crit stacks at cap (Yun Tal)
onhit            flat on-hit riders: base (+ apRatio x AP + bonusAdRatio x bonus AD
+ maxManaPct% of max mana); optional source label
onhitCurrentHp   % of target CURRENT health on-hit (melee/ranged variants)
spellblade       next attack after an ability cast: baseAdRatio x base AD + apRatio x AP;
reapplyOnhit: Dusk and Dawn applies on-hit effects again
asStacking       per-attack stacking bonus AS (Rageblade Seething Strike)
phantom          Guinsoo phantom-hit stack machine (every 3rd attack at full stacks)
kraken           every-3rd-attack proc with level scaling and missing-HP amp
altPen           Terminus Dark hits: stacking % armor+magic pen (every 2nd attack)
dmgAmp           time-in-combat damage amp: pctPerStack per second, capped
flatAmp          always-on damage amp for one damage type (Abyssal Mask)
giantSlayer      amp vs target bonus HP: 1% per 100, capped at maxPct (LDR)
burn             refreshing DoT on ability damage: Liandry (maxHpPctTotal)
or Blackfire (totalBase + totalApRatio); source labels the breakdown
magicCrit        Shadowflame: magic damage always crits for critDmgPct below the threshold
navoriCdr        on-attack % reduction of remaining basic-ability cooldowns
flurry           Yun Tal AS window: asPct for durationS, cooldownS with on-hit refunds
executePct       Collector: damage leaving the target below this % executes
stormsurge       proc after dealing thresholdPct of max HP within windowS
abilityManaProc  Muramana Shock: % max mana physical per damaging ability cast
abilityProcOnce  Luden's: one proc on the first ability damage (recharge unknown)
ultHaste         ability haste for R only
ultBurn          Malignance: burn zone + flat MR reduction on R damage
covers           passive names accounted for (or knowingly irrelevant to
damage, per the note), so stat sheets stop listing them
